description: This file is a generated Java class for registering Flutter plugins on the Android platform. It programmatically adds plugin instances to the FlutterEngine, specifically SharedPreferencesPlugin and SqflitePlugin.

classes.name: GeneratedPluginRegistrant
classes.description: A utility class auto-generated by Flutter to register plugins with the Android FlutterEngine.

methods.name: registerWith
methods.description: Registers specified plugins with the provided FlutterEngine instance, handling exceptions and logging errors if plugin registration fails.
